name: Freedom Arrow — 0.8 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.8: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.8.0-dev.18: FAModels 0.3.17 infantry body fix; ZBL-191 with HJ-16 (1500 m), APS and SRAT II armour (105); 0.8.0-dev.16: transport cleanup (no logistics vehicles, Shaanxi Troop Truck or Z-20T as squad transports, CSK-131 merged, CSK-181 in Airborne/Navy/Motorized, Chinese Lynx weapons); 0.8.0-dev.14: HJ-10 is a semi-active Hellfire that fires at spotted enemies without its own line of sight (runtime hook); CH-901 is a CTL-181-style munition. Includes the dev.8 aircraft batch and CTL-181 NLOS (8 damage, 1800 m). Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.0.
